intent.raw: Create a User ledger and Guide family for adaptive understanding, vocabulary preferences, cross-domain explanation, install onboarding game, and mastered-definition glossary.
intent.objective: Refine a candidate Arcanum User/Guide capability family without executing implementation or canonical promotion.
intent.operator_sentence: User is a ledger and Guide uses it to adapt understanding across domains.

route_menu.context_hint: Choose the first coherent unit for a new User/Guide framework part.

items.label: Ledger And Receipts First
items.description: Define the user learning ledger and Guide interaction receipt contract before building Guide behavior.

items.label: Guide Spell First
items.description: Start with a conversational Guide spell and infer ledger needs from use.

items.label: Install Game First
items.description: Build the CyberAlchemy onboarding game first and defer ledger generalization.

technique_overlays.trigger: The target needs a full local refine run with traceable artifacts.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage records artifact evidence or an explicit block without mutating canonical surfaces.

technique_overlays.trigger: The request could start from ledger, guide behavior, install game, glossary, or software concept library.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The selected first unit is explicit and rejected alternatives are preserved.

technique_overlays.trigger: The design must balance personalization with privacy, learning help with overfitting, and user memory with canonical knowledge promotion.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Roles, convergence criteria, and unresolved residue are recorded.

technique_overlays.trigger: Guide must translate across domains and between concrete, meta, and abstract understanding layers.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The design names the hidden structure: user profile, concept library, explanation strategy, receipt, ledger update, and glossary update.

technique_overlays.trigger: The CyberAlchemy installation game should test prior-experience mapping before durable personalization exists.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The game has explicit evidence outputs and failure interpretation.

technique_overlays.trigger: User profile, learning history, and preference evidence are sensitive and must not silently become canonical memory.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: User-ledger writes are namespaced, reviewable, and separate from Inventory/Ontology/registry promotion.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: block if Craft ledger reference artifacts cannot be read

steps.name: Invoke Define
stop_conditions: block if define claims canonical User or Guide promotion

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: selected first unit is smaller than the whole Guide system
user memory and canonical knowledge promotion are separated
Guide adaptation has receipts and reviewable evidence
stop_conditions: block if user ledger becomes unrestricted surveillance or canonical memory

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: block if research attempts to create medical, psychological, or diagnostic user profiling

steps.name: Distill
stop_conditions: block if no coherent unit can connect Guide behavior to User ledger updates

steps.name: Invoke Redefine / Design
stop_conditions: block if design writes actual user profile data or install-game runtime state

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
convergence_criteria: ledger fields are minimum viable and not invasive
Guide can adapt from evidence without claiming certainty about the user
concept library is seedable but not required to cover all domains
stop_conditions: block if mastered definitions can be added without user confirmation or retrieval evidence

steps.name: Distill Repair
stop_conditions: block if the repaired unit cannot recompose into User sigils, Guide spells, and install-game spell

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: block if plan executes implementation instead of creating a non-executed route

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Synthesis
stop_conditions: block if synthesis does not name next routes and canonical mutation boundaries

gates.condition: This run must not promote User or Guide into canonical arcana, spells, registry entries, commands, runtime adapters, install hooks, user memory stores, Inventory, or Ontology.
REFINE-DISPATCH.json validates against formulae/dispatch-spec/dispatch.schema.yml and technique governance.
User profile evidence is treated as protected local context; no profiling beyond learning preferences, prior experience, and confirmed mastery evidence is designed in this run.
A mastered definition requires user confirmation plus retrieval, teach-back, or transfer evidence; a single passive 'I understand' is at most partial mastery.
The install game elicits prior domains and vocabulary anchors without becoming a psychological assessment or mandatory gate to use the system.

boundaries.contract: Guide may propose ledger updates only through interaction receipts and user-confirmable evidence.
A user glossary entry records user mastery; it does not promote a canonical definition into Inventory or Ontology.

authority.execution: blocked until task-session or sigil-development approval
authority.validation: dispatch-spec schema plus final refine synthesis
authority.memory: candidate User ledger only, not written in this run

state_namespaces.write_policy: Allowed writes are limited to seed, dispatch, handoff, stage evidence, manifest, and result under development/user-guide/refinement-runs/20260529T131319Z-user-guide-ledger/. Registry, arcana/user, spells/guide, persistent user profile, and installer runtime writes are blocked.

promotion_splits.rule: A user-local explanation or mastery note cannot become a canonical definition without separate owner review and validation; on conflict, preserve it as a preference note.

promotion_guardrails: Do not create canonical User or Guide sigils in this run.
Do not create persistent user memory state in this run.
Do not treat clarification count as intelligence, ability, or psychological diagnosis.
Do not add mastered definitions without user-visible confirmation and evidence.
Do not let a domain analogy replace the target concept definition.
